title: ESLint configuration file generator
description: Generate a standardized ESLint config file.

project.description: The name of the project where the ESLint config should be generated. If omitted, a workspace config is generated.

configType.description: Generate a workspace-level config or a project-level config. Defaults to project when project is provided, otherwise workspace.

configureOptions.description: Options to pass as the first argument to configure().

additionalConfigs.description: JavaScript expressions or config objects to append as additional configure() arguments. Only supported for workspace configs.

extend.description: The path to a base ESLint config to extend for project-level configs.

skipDependencies.description: Skip installing dependencies to the project.

dryRun.description: Don't actually write to the file system.
